ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a circle, point I is marked inside the circle and serves as the center; points D and G are on the circumference. Segments ID and IG connect from the center to points on the circumference, so they are radii; segment DG is a chord connecting two points on the circle. Triangle D I G is formed in the figure. Reasoning: Given m∠DGI = 24°, and r = 6. Because ID and IG are both radii of the circle, ID = IG, and triangle DIG is an isosceles triangle. Therefore the base angles are equal, ∠IDG = ∠DGI = 24°. The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so the central angle ∠DIG = 180° - 24° - 24° = 132°. The central angle corresponding to arc DG is 132°, and the arc length formula is s = (θ/360)·2πr. Substituting θ = 132°, r = 6, gives s = (132/360)·2π·6 = (132/360)·12π = 22π/5.

raw_record.question_text: Find $\widehat{D G}$ if $m \angle D G I=24$ and $r=6$

method.method_draft: Use the isosceles triangle formed by the two radii. From the image, identify I as the circle’s center, with D and G on the circle, so ID and IG are radii and triangle DIG is isosceles. From the text, take m∠DGI = 24° and r = 6. Since ID = IG, the base angles at D and G are equal, so ∠IDG = 24°. Then the central angle ∠DIG intercepting arc DG is 180° - 24° - 24° = 132°. Convert that central angle to arc length using s = (132/360)(2π·6), giving 22π/5.

推理：已知 m∠DGI = 24°，且 r = 6。因为 ID 和 IG 都是圆的半径，所以 ID = IG，三角形 DIG 是等腰三角形。因此底角相等，∠IDG = ∠DGI = 24°。三角形内角和为 180°，所以圆心角 ∠DIG = 180° - 24° - 24° = 132°。弧 DG 对应的圆心角是 132°，弧长公式为 s = (θ/360)·2πr。代入 θ = 132°，r = 6，得到 s = (132/360)·2π·6 = (132/360)·12π = 22π/5。

method.method_draft: Introduce an auxiliary tangent at G. From the image, note that IG is a radius to point G and DG is a chord. From the text, m∠DGI = 24° and r = 6. Draw a tangent line at G; it is perpendicular to radius IG, so the angle between the tangent and chord GD is 90° - 24° = 66°. By the tangent-chord theorem, this tangent-chord angle equals half the measure of its intercepted arc DG, so arc DG has measure 2·66° = 132°. Then compute arc length as (132/360)(2π·6) = 22π/5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个圆，点 D 和点 G 在圆周下方，DG 是圆内的一条弦；点 I 在圆内作为圆心，线段 IG 连到圆周点 G，因此 IG 是半径。题目给出 m∠DGI = 24°，半径 r = 6。推理：在 G 点作圆的切线。因为半径 IG 垂直于 G 点切线，所以切线与弦 GD 的夹角为 90° - 24° = 66°。根据切线-弦定理，切线与弦所成角等于其所截弧 DG 的度数的一半，因此弧 DG 的度数为 2 × 66° = 132°。弧长 = (132/360) × 2πr = (132/360) × 2π × 6 = 22π/5。
